stem: Why is John Paul Jones a significant figure in U.S. history?

options.label: A
options.text: He is considered to be the best Union general in the Civil War.

options.label: B
options.text: He was the first chief justice of the U.S. Supreme Court.

options.label: C
options.text: He is considered to be a founder of the U.S. Navy.

options.label: D
options.text: He was the writer of the Declaration of Independence.
